# ops_workspace_variable (Resource)

A variable of a workspace: an environment variable (e.g. cloud credentials) or a Terraform input variable. A sensitive value is write-only in OPS: Terraform can't see a change made to it in the UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ops_workspace_variable" "tags" {
  workspace_id = ops_workspace.shop.id
  category     = "terraform"
  key          = "tags"
  value        = "{team = \"shop\"}"
  hcl          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) `env` (an environment variable) or `terraform` (a Terraform input variable).
- `key` (String) Its name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Its value; with `hcl`, an HCL literal such as `{env = "prd"}` or `["a", "b"]`.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace's id.

### Optional

- `hcl` (Boolean) Terraform variables: the value is HCL, for list, map, object, number or bool variables.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Write-only: never shown again, masked in run logs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ops_workspace_variable.tags <workspace_id>/<variable_id>
```
